个.o: Pictograph of one stalk of bamboo. Same as one half of the character for bamboo (竹).
w: every; various; separately, one by one
x: 我有一个问题。
Wǒ yǒu yī gè wèntí.
I have a question.
这个酒店很卫生。
Zhège jiǔdiàn hěn wèishēng.
This hotel is very hygienic.
请保管好个人物品。
Qǐng bǎoguǎn hǎo gèrén wùpǐn.
Please do not leave your personal belongings unattended.
co: able to recognize only a handful of Chinese characters; illiterate

說.o: Phonosemantic compound. 言 represents the meaning and 兌 represents the sound.

自.o: Pictograph of a nose. Original form of 鼻 (nose). In China, when people point to themselves, they typically point to their nose.
w: to kill oneself; to commit suicide
x: 自己拿吧！
Zìjǐ ná ba!
Help yourself!
我来自中国大陆。
Wǒ láizì Zhōngguó dàlù.
I am from mainland China.
我现在感觉很自由。
Wǒ xiànzài gǎnjiào hěn zìyóu.
I feel really free now.
co: to uphold one's rights and interests

只.o: Origin unclear. In simplified Chinese, in addition to the meaning "only", 只 is also used as a measure word. In traditional Chinese this meaning is written as 隻.
w: can only; obliged to do sth
without any better option; to have to
to have no alternative but to
x: 我只去过一次。
Wǒ zhǐ qù guò yī cì.
I've only been there once.
他只是一个小孩。
Tā zhǐshì yīge xiǎohái.
He is only a child.
只要有信心，困难必战胜。
Zhǐyào yǒu xìnxīn, kùnnan bì zhànshèng.
Difficulties can be overcome so long as you have confidence.

太.o: Addition of a dot to 大 (dà; big) to mean "very" or "extremely".
x: 别吃太多派。
Bié chī tài duō pài.
Don't eat too much pie.
今天太阳不错。
Jīntiān tàiyáng bùcuò.
It's a sunny day today.
这位是陈太太。
Zhèwèi shì chén tàitài.
This is Mrs Chen.

哪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 口 represents the meaning and 那 represents the sound.
x: 你是从哪个国家来的？
Nǐ shì cóng nǎ ge guójiā lái de?
Which country are you from?
请问哪里有洗手间？
Qǐngwèn nǎlǐ yǒu xǐshǒujiān?
Could you tell me where the nearest bathroom is?
我爸爸告诉了我去哪儿。
Wǒ bàbà gàosù le wǒ qù nǎr.
My dad told me where to go.

親.o: Phonosemantic compound. 見 represents the meaning and 亲 represents the sound.

枪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 木 represents the meaning and 仓 represents the sound. Simplified form of 槍.
w: to open fire; to shoot a gun
to shoot with a gun; shooting incident
x: 赶快停止你的动作，否则我们要开枪了！
Gǎnkuài tíngzhǐ nǐ de dòngzuò, fǒuzé wǒmen yào kāiqiāng le!
Stop what you are doing or we'll open fire!
他的骂声像机关枪一样传来。
Tā de màshēng xiàng jīguānqiāng yīyàng chuán lái.
He spewed forth abuse like a machine gun.

未.o: Similar to 木 (tree), with extra branches added. Based on the original meaning "tree trunk", now written as 枚. The current meaning is a phonetic loan.
w: cannot; to fail to; unable to
x: 我们从未忘记。
Wǒmen cóngwèi wàngjì.
We never forget.
看不见一个未来，我可以享受现在。
Kàn bu jiàn yī ge wèilái, wǒ kěyǐ xiǎngshòu xiànzài.
[Although I] cannot foresee a [bright] future, I can enjoy the present.

c.h: 忄 is a component form of 心.

怪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 忄 represents the meaning and 圣 represents the sound.
x: 味道有点怪。
Wèidào yǒudiǎn guài.
It tastes funny.
别怪他。
Bié guài tā.
Don't blame him.

c.h: In ancient China shells were used as currency.

質.o: Phonosemantic compound. 斦 represents the sound and 貝 represents the meaning.

罪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 网 represents the meaning and 非 represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "fishing net". The current meaning, originally written 辠, is a phonetic loan.
w: to commit a crime; crime; offense
to commit an offense; to violate the law
x: 如果他得罪了你，那他是有嘴无心。
Rúguǒ tā dézuì le nǐ, nà tā shì yǒuzuǐwúxīn.
If he has offended you, he does not mean it.
他招认全部犯罪行为。
Tā zhāorèn quánbù fànzuì xíngwèi.
He confessed all his crimes.
co: to be convicted; to be found guilty

c.h: 阝 is a component form of 阜.

險.o: Phonosemantic compound. 阝 represents the meaning and 僉 represents the sound.

c.h: 纟 is a component form of 糸.

纪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 纟 represents the meaning and 己 represents the sound. Simplified form of 紀.
x: 他的年纪已经不小了。
Tā de niánjì yǐjīng bù xiǎo le.
He's not a young person anymore.
今天是一个值得纪念的日子。
Jīntiān shì yīge zhídé jìniàn de rìzi.
Today is a day worth commemorating.
纪律懈怠。
Jìlǜ xièdài.
Discipline is lax.
co: ... (despite being) at such a young age

c.h: 辶 is a component form of 辵.

迪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 辶 represents the meaning and 由 represents the sound.
x: 莫迪曾担任古吉拉特邦首席部长。
Mòdí céng dānrèn gǔjílātè bāng shǒuxíbùcháng.
Narendra Modi held office of the chief minister of Gujarat

踪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 足 represents the meaning and 宗 represents the sound. Simplified form of 蹤.
w: to be missing; to disappear; unaccounted for
to follow sb's tracks; to tail; to shadow
to follow a trail; to trace; to pursue

航.o: Phonosemantic compound. 舟 represents the meaning and 亢 represents the sound.
w: to sail; to fly; to navigate
x: 请留意您乘坐航班的登机时间，以免误机。
Qǐng liúyì nín chéngzuò hángbān de dēngjī shíjiān, yǐmiǎn wùjī.
Please pay attention to the boarding time so you don't miss your flight.
航班晚点了，害我多等了两个小时。
Hángbān wǎndiǎn le, hài wǒ duō děng le liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
The flight was delayed, causing me to wait for another two hours.
co: to turn on the navigation system

c.h: 亻 is a component form of 人.

優.o: Phonosemantic compound. 亻 represents the meaning and 憂 represents the sound.

c.h: 阝 is a component form of 阜.

陪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 阝 represents the meaning and 咅 represents the sound.
w: (honorific) to accompany; to keep sb company
to be buried with or next to dead person (of deceased's partner,…
x: 在我去医院探望妈妈时，他一直陪着我。
Zài wǒ qù yīyuàn tànwàng māma shí, tā yīzhí péizhe wǒ.
He kept me company while I visited mum in hospital.
我失陪了。
Wǒ shīpéi le.
Excuse me, but I must be going.
在我去医院探望妈妈时，他一直陪著我。
Zài wǒ qù yīyuàn tànwàng māma shí, tā yīzhí péizhe wǒ.
He kept me company while I visited mum in hospital.

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

浪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 良 represents the sound.
w: to drift about; to wander; to roam
x: 别在他身上浪费时间了。
Bié zài tā shēnshàng làngfèi shíjiān le.
Don't waste time on him.
他和流浪街头的孩子交上了朋友。
Tā hé liúlàng jiētóu de háizǐ jiāo shàng le péngyǒu.
He has made friends with the kids on the street.
co: to not understand romance; to be unromantic

c.h: 奴 also serves as a meaning component.

努.o: Phonosemantic compound. 力 represents the meaning and 奴 represents the sound.
w: great effort; to strive; to try hard
to exert, strive, make an effort; to pout
to pout; to stick out one's lips
x: 要是现在不努力的话，将来会后悔的。
Yàoshì xiànzài bù nǔlì dehuà, jiānglái huì hòuhuǐ de.
If you don't work hard now, you'll regret it later on.
我会好好努力把我的博士读完。
Wǒ huì hǎohǎo nǔlì bǎ wǒ de bóshì dúwán.
I will work hard to finish my doctorate.
co: yī ge fēicháng nǔlì de yuángōng

瑪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 玉 represents the meaning and 馬 represents the sound.

輪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 車 represents the meaning and 侖 represents the sound.

聪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 耳 represents the meaning and 总 represents the sound. Simplified form of 聰.
w: to go deaf; to lose hearing
x: 他生得很聪明。
Tā shēng de hěn cōngmíng.
He is very smart.
她既漂亮，又聪明可爱！
Tā jì piàoliàng, yòu cōngmíng kě'ài!
She's beautiful, smart, and cute!

雪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 雨 represents the meaning and 彗 represents the sound.
x: 外面正在下雪。
Wàimiàn zhèngzài xiàxuě.
It's snowing outside.
人民的眼睛是雪亮的。
Rénmín de yǎnjing shì xuěliàng de.
The people's eyes are discerning.

訪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 言 represents the meaning and 方 represents the sound.

闪.o: Simplified form of 閃. Depicts a person (人) peeking through the space in the middle of a door (门). Based on the original meaning "peek". The meaning later shifted to "dodge" and "flash".
w: to glint; to glitter; to sparkle
to get out of the way
x: 那司机为什么对我闪车灯？
Nà sījī wèishénme duì wǒ shǎn chēdēng?
Why is the driver flashing his lights at me?
外面一直在闪电。
Wàimiàn yīzhí zài shǎndiàn.
There have been incessant flashes of lightning outside.
星光闪耀。
Xīngguāng shǎnyào.
The stars shine.

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

措.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 昔 represents the sound.
w: not knowing what to do (idiom); at one's wits' end
to lose one's head out of fear (idiom)
no time to deal with it (idiom); caught unprepared
at a loss to know what to do (idiom); bewildered
x: 枪炮声使群众惊慌失措。
Qiāngpào shēng shǐ qúnzhòng jīnghuāngshīcuò.
The crowd panicked at the sound of the guns.

奪.o: Depicts a hand (寸) snatching a bird (隹). The top component was originally 衣 (clothes), depicting a person holding a bird in their clothes, but later it was reanalyzed as a phonetic component, written as either 兌 or 大.

c.h: 犭 is a component form of 犬.

猪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 犭 represents the meaning and 者 represents the sound. Simplified form of 豬.
x: 你这只猪，别挡路！
Nǐ zhè zhī zhū, bié dǎng lù!
Out of my way, pig!
我不爱吃猪肉。
Wǒ bù ài chī zhūròu.
I don't like to eat pork.

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

泪.o: Simplified form of 淚. Depicts drops of water (氵) coming from the eye (目).
w: eyes brimming with tears of excitement (idiom)
x: 做菜忘了开抽油烟机，烟得我流泪。
Zuòcài wàng le kāi chōuyóuyānjī, yān de wǒ liúlèi.
When I was cooking, I forgot to turn on the range hood, and the smoke made my eyes water.
大楼正在进行封顶仪式。
Dàlóu zhèngzài jìnxíng fēngdǐng yíshì.
The building is undergoing the topping out ceremony.

横.o: Phonosemantic compound. 木 represents the meaning and 黄 represents the sound. Simplified form of 橫.
w: to sweep away; to sweep across
to go on the rampage; to riot; to run amuck
lit. warp and weft in weaving; vertically and horizontal
x: 注意横风。
Zhùyì héngfēng.
Beware of crosswind.
这个大堂直里有八米，横里有十米。
Zhè ge dàtáng zhí lǐ yǒu bā mǐ, héng lǐ yǒu shí mǐ.
This hall is 8 meters in length and 10 meters in width.

洪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 共 represents the sound.
x: 许多房屋被洪水冲走了。
Xǔduō fángwū bèi hóngshuǐ chōngzǒu le.
A lot of houses were washed away by the flood.

c.h: 纟 is a component form of 糸.

绪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 纟 represents the meaning and 者 represents the sound. Simplified form of 緒.
w: to be ready; to be in order
train of thought; emotional state; mood
to be in a bad mood
x: 这个问题我也一直在想，但现在还没理出一个头绪来。
Zhè ge wèntí wǒ yě yīzhí zài xiǎng, dàn xiànzài hái méi lǐ chū yī ge tóuxù lái.
I've been thinking about this problem too, but I haven't figured it out yet.

豪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 豕 represents the meaning and 高 represents the sound.
x: 双腿残疾，被父母抛弃，她顽强生活，成为千万富豪。
Shuāngtuǐ cánjí, bèi fùmǔ pāoqì, tā wánqiáng shēnghuó, chéngwéi qiānwàn fùháo.
Disabled in both legs and abandoned by her parents, she lived tenaciously and became a multimillionaire.

喪.o: Depicts multiple mouths (吅) wailing to mourn the death (亡) of someone. 桑 and 亡 represent the sound.

盪.o: Hot soup 湯 in a bowl 皿; 湯 also provides the pronunciation

邪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 牙 represents the sound and ⻏ represents the meaning. Based on the original use as a place name. The current meaning is a phonetic loan.
w: wrong, evil, depraved, vicious, perverse, heterodox
wicked idea; evil thought; evil desire

c.h: Used here to depict an animal's claw.
Depicts an animal's paw. Modern form looks like unrelated 田.

番.o: Depicts an animal's claw (釆) with their paw shown. 釆 also represents the sound. Based on the original meaning "animal's paw", now written as 蹯. The current meaning is a phonetic loan.
w: to take turns; a turn, a time; to repeat
x: 你要番茄酱吗？
Nǐ yào fānqiéjiàng ma?
Do you want ketchup?

宪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 宀 represents the meaning and 先 represents the sound. Simplified form of 憲.
x: 《德意志联邦共和国基本法》是德国现行的宪法。
“Déyìzhì Liánbāng Gònghéguó Jīběnfǎ” shì Déguó xiànxíng de xiànfǎ.
The Basic Law for the Federal Republic of Germany is the current constitution of Germany.

剪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 刀 represents the meaning and 前 represents the sound.
x: 他把不结果的枝都修剪掉。
Tā bǎ bù jiēguǒ de zhī dōu xiūjiǎn diào.
He pruned every branch that did not bear fruit.

咪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 口 represents the meaning and 米 represents the sound.
w: sound of cat, cat's meow; meter
x: 猫咪睡得很熟。
Māomī shuì de hěn shú.
The cat is sleeping soundly.
来，来，小咪咪。
Lái, lái, xiǎo mīmī.
Here kitty kitty.

截.o: A bird 隹 cut off from its nest 十 by a weapon 戈
w: to close; to stop; to put a stop to sth
to intercept; to cut off and capture

c.h: 亻 is a component form of 人.

伪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 亻 represents the meaning and 为 represents the sound. Simplified form of 偽.
w: to pretend to be (asleep etc); pretense
to forge; to fake; to counterfeit
x: 这个伪君子也教不出什么好学生来。
Zhège wěijūnzǐ yě jiāobuchū shénme hǎo xuéshēng lái.
This hypocrite as a teacher couldn't produce any good students.
他怀疑电视里的主播已经被伪人替换了。
Tā huáiyí diànshì lǐ de zhǔbō yǐjīng bèi wěirén tìhuàn le.
He suspected that the anchor on TV had been replaced by an alterative.
co: to crack down on counterfeit and low-quality (goods)

c.h: 釒 is a component form of 金.

鋪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 釒 represents the meaning and 甫 represents the sound.

w: to follow; to abide by; to comply with
to follow the compass and go with the set square (idiom); to…
in sequence, step by step (idiom); to make steady progress…
(idiom) to continue in the same old rut

酪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 酉 represents the meaning and 各 represents the sound.

堪.o: One with a considerable amount 甚 of land 土
w: can be rated as; can be said to be
to be unable to withstand a single blow
x: 后果不堪设想。
Hòuguǒ bùkānshèxiǎng.
The consequences will be disastrous.
你让我情何以堪？
Nǐ ràng wǒ qínghéyǐkān?
How did you expect me to take it? / Did you think of me at all?

c.h: 糹 is a component form of 糸.

繪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 糹 represents the meaning and 會 represents the sound.

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

攪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 覺 represents the sound.

貪.o: Depicts a mouth (今) facing a shell (貝). In ancient China, shells were used as currency. 今 also represents the sound.

贪.o: Depicts a mouth (今) facing a shell (贝). In ancient China, shells were used as currency. 今 also represents the sound. Simplified form of 貪.
w: to be corrupt; corruption; to embezzle
avaricious and insatiable (idiom); greedy and never satisfied
x: 做人不要这么贪心。
Zuòrén bùyào zhème tānxīn.
Don't be so greedy in life.
你这个人太贪心。
Nǐ zhè ge rén tài tānxīn.
You are too greedy of a person.
co: to be anxious to get things on the cheap
to have embezzled several hundred million

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

汪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 王 represents the sound.

c.h: 釒 is a component form of 金.

鑪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 釒 represents the meaning and 盧 represents the sound.

c.h: 艹 is a component form of 艸.

薪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 艹 represents the meaning and 新 represents the sound. Originally written as 新.
x: 澳大利亚的薪水是多少？——差别很大。
Àodàlìyà de xīnshuǐ shì duōshào? — chābié hěn dà.
What are salaries like in Australia? -- It varies greatly.
老板只知要求员工加班，却从不加薪，简直是吸血鬼。
Lǎobǎn zhǐ zhī yāoqiú yuángōng jiābān, què cóngbù jiāxīn, jiǎnzhí shì xīxuèguǐ.
The boss only knew to ask employees to work overtime, but never paid them raise. What a parasite.

c.h: 扌 is a component form of 手.

挪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 扌 represents the meaning and 那 represents the sound.
w: to move (sth) aside; to step aside
to move; to shift; to move out of the way
x: 把桌子挪到那边去。
Bǎ zhuōzi nuó dào nàbiān qù.
Move the table to that side.
这笔钱不能挪。
Zhè bǐ qián bùnéng nuó.
This money cannot be diverted.

瞪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 目 represents the meaning and 登 represents the sound.
w: to open one's eyes wide; to stare

x: 那两名匪徒当场毙命。
Nà liǎng míng fěitú dāngchǎng bìmìng.
Those two robbers were killed at the scene.

姪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 女 represents the meaning and 至 represents the sound.
w: son of a male cousin via female line

跪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 足 represents the meaning and 危 represents the sound.
w: to kneel; to go down on one's knees
to kneel down; to sink to one's knees
to kowtow; to kneel and worship
to kneel as in prayer (without sitting back on the heels)
x: 给我跪下！
Gěi wǒ guìxià!
Kneel!
与其跪着生，毋宁站着死。
Yǔqí guìzhe shēng, wúnìng zhànzhe sǐ.
It's better to die standing rather than live kneeling.

琪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 王 represents the meaning and 其 represents the sound.

c.h: 氵 is a component form of 水.

溪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 氵 represents the meaning and 奚 represents the sound. Simplified form of 谿.

禪.o: To pray 礻 alone 單; 單 also provides the pronunciation

w: to lean unsteadily from side to side (idiom)
(of a couple) to be sweet to each other

爪.o: Pictograph of a hand pointing downwards.
w: to bare fangs and brandish claws (idiom); to make threatening gestures
lit. one scale and half a claw (idiom); only odd bits and pieces
x: 我早就把烦恼丢到爪哇国了。
Wǒ zǎo jiù bǎ fánnǎo diū dào Zhǎowāguó le.
I since the early on have thrown away my sorrow.

刪.o: To cut 刂 out passages from a book 冊

噪.o: Phonosemantic compound. 口 represents the meaning and 喿 represents the sound.
w: to achieve fame among one's contemporaries (idiom); temporary or…
x: 房客如果制造噪音而影响安宁，怎么办？
Fángkè rúguǒ zhìzào zàoyīn ér yǐngxiǎng ānníng, zěnmebàn?
What do you do if tenants create noise and affect the (area’s) tranquility?
傍晚，燕雀的狂噪穿过暮蔼在天空回绕。
Bàngwǎn, yànquè de kuáng zào chuānguò mù ǎi zài tiānkōng huí rào.
In the evening, the wild noise of swallows echoed through the amiable twilight sky.

彪.o: A tiger's 虎 stripes 彡

c.h: Used here to depict garbage or feces.

粪.o: Depicts two hands (廾) using a dustpan (其) to sweep away garbage or feces. Based on the original meaning "to clean up". The meaning later shifted to "manure".

株.o: Phonosemantic compound. 木 represents the meaning and 朱 represents the sound. Originally written as 朱.
w: lit. to guard a tree-stump, waiting for rabbits (idiom)
x: 金融监管不能守株待兔。
Jīnróng jiānguǎn bùnéng shǒuzhūdàitù.
The government should not just wait for problems to come up when handling financial regulation.
